title: Companions
meta: How companions write their Soul and read your mood
writerIntro: Drafts a companion's Soul from its character text: who they are, what they value, how they talk. Nothing is saved until you keep the draft.
backupHint: The backup model takes over when the writer model fails or returns something unusable.
promptHint: Make your own in System prompts.
whereBody: Open a companion's editor, go to Soul and choose Generate from character. It uses the settings on this page.
noBackupBody: Stop if the writer model fails
noModelsBody: Add a text chat model to use the Soul writer.
managePromptsBody: Create or edit a Soul writer prompt
emotionsIntro: Thymos reads the feeling behind each message in a companion chat. Companions use it to keep track of their mood and how close you are.
damaged: Some files are missing or broken
missingHint: Without it, companion chats still work, but mood and closeness don't change from what you say.
damagedBody: Repair downloads the missing files again. Companion moods stay where they are until then.
keepInMemoryBody: Skips loading it before each message. Uses more memory while the app is open.
deleteHint: Frees its disk space. You can download it again any time.
deleteBody: The emotion model is removed from this device. Companion moods stay where they are until you download it again.
feelingsBody_one: {{count}} feeling, from joy and gratitude to grief and nervousness
feelingsBody_other: {{count}} feelings, from joy and gratitude to grief and nervousness
privacy: Runs on this device. Your messages are not sent anywhere to be read.
